These days, finding time to be outside can feel like a treat. But going outside isn’t just for fun—it’s necessary. It revives us. It brings us together. It creates special memories that will last long after the sun’s gone down, which is why we’re committed to Protecting the Fun on Earth. Banana Boat sunscreen will make sure you’re protected from the sun—no matter if you’re breaking a sweat or not sweating a thing. So go ahead, get out there to soak it all up! The best fun needs protection you can trust, and Banana Boat sunscreen lasts as long as the fun does!

quotes.quote: At Edgewell, we bring joy to people where it matters most. Explore our portfolio of leading shave, grooming, sun, skin and feminine care products.

We’re an award-winning shave and body care brand built for womankind. It all started when we noticed that women were paying a “pink tax” on razors, and that they were being shamed for having body hair. This inspired us to design a fairly priced razor for the way women actually shave, and to become the first women's shave brand to put body hair on the big screen in 100 years. Since then, we’ve won a variety of awards, and got dubbed “the internet’s favorite razor” for creating products that elevate women’s daily routines with feel-good formulas that work harder and smarter. Above all, we seek to champion womankind by challenging societal pressures and creating space for them to be exactly who they are.
